data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-2: Mutation dataclass carries (direction in {inbound, outbound}, action in enumerated taxonomy including create/update/delete/probe/clean_label/repair_property/conflict, target, payload, provenance); invalid combinations raise at construction

Create `plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/mutation.py` defining MutationDirection StrEnum (inbound, outbound), MutationAction StrEnum (create, update, delete, probe, clean_label, repair_property, conflict), Mutation @dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True) with fields (direction, action, target, payload, provenance). __post_init__ validates (direction, action) via frozen _VALID_COMBINATIONS mapping. Invariants: clean_label and repair_property are inbound-only; invalid combinations raise ValueError. target non-empty str; payload and provenance are Mapping (allow empty dicts).

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given a Mutation constructor invocation with direction=outbound and action=clean_label; When Mutation(...) is called; Then __post_init__ raises ValueError mentioning both 'direction' and 'action'.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/mutation.py tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_mutation.py
- [ ] Mutation(direction=outbound, action=clean_label, ...) raises ValueError
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_mutation.py::test_outbound_clean_label_rejected
- [ ] Mutation(direction=outbound, action=repair_property, ...) raises ValueError
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_mutation.py::test_outbound_repair_property_rejected
- [ ] Mutation is hashable and immutable (frozen=True, slots=True)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_mutation.py::test_mutation_is_frozen_hashable
- [ ] MutationAction enum exactly matches {create, update, delete, probe, clean_label, repair_property, conflict}
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_mutation.py::test_action_enum_membership
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_outbound_clean_label_rejected] for plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/mutation.py
  Verify: grep -F '[test_outbound_clean_label_rejected]' .test-index

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/mutation.py — Create
- tests/unit/dso_reconciler/test_mutation.py — Create

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus, escalate to user
